issue.title: Flaky test: test_artifact_file_modal_copy_palette_formats_marked_sets_and_skips
issue.description: Observed as FAILED during a full 'just check' parallel run (tests/ace/tui/modals/test_artifact_files_modal_copy.py::test_artifact_file_modal_copy_palette_formats_marked_sets_and_skips), but passes reliably in isolation and on a subsequent full-suite rerun. Likely test-order/parallelism state leakage (clipboard or marked-set state bleeding across tests) rather than a real regression. Discovered while fixing the published-core-minimum-smoke CI failure (unrelated: that fix only touched pyproject.toml's sase-core-rs floor and its accompanying test). Worth investigating for shared/global state (e.g. clipboard mock, marked-set singleton) that isn't reset between tests under xdist.
